title: Definitions — Closed-Lease Share on Utility Pass-Through Service Late Fees
content:
**Closed-lease share.** For a late fee on a Utility Pass-Through Service statement, where the lease the account serves has closed and a notice to vacate was accepted on it, the late fee is reduced to 75 percent, because the statement reaches the former resident at a forwarding address; where the lease has closed with no notice to vacate accepted on it, the late fee is reduced to 90 percent; a late fee on the account of an open lease takes no closed-lease share.

## Definitions

- **The lease the account serves**: the Home-Site Lease the utility account was opened for.
- **Closed**: the Home-Site Lease shows the status closed.
- **Notice to vacate accepted on it**: the lease's requests include a notice to vacate whose status is accepted.
- **Open lease**: any Home-Site Lease status other than closed.
- **Effect**: the share multiplies the fee basis — the amount the statement's late fee is figured from — before the fee is rounded half up to the cent once.

## Applying the definitions (hypothetical)

| Home-Site Lease status | Accepted notice to vacate on the lease | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Closed | Yes | 75 percent |
| Closed | No | 90 percent |
| Notice to vacate (still open) | Yes | none |
| Active | No | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical fee basis 12.00).** Closed lease with an accepted notice to vacate: 12.00 times 75 percent is 9.00.
